//: Story Phase 16: novelty devices. THE GRAND STENCHMASTER'S GRAND LIGHTER OF GRAND SMOKES (Cheap-O-Rama, with Cheapy the Cheapskate Clown on the box): working, not reliable. Every attempt ever made is counted (lighter_clicks) and gets the next outcome in a fixed sequence, so it is unreliable without being random; a scene that needs a flame forces the last attempt ('until'). It's an obviously fictional novelty: nothing about it is a real device or a real procedure.

spark.text: A weak spark. It thinks about it. It decides against it.

brown_puff.text: A small brownish puff comes out of the top, and smells briefly of a fart on fire.

smell.text: No flame. Just a smell, like a candle that's been told a secret about beans.

sputter.text: A flame! For a moment! It sputters and goes out, looking embarrassed.

flame.text: A flame. A little, ordinary, steady flame. It just... works.
